items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I used to even tell -- later after I'd worked for Ben and worked for Woody, I worked for them as a side man.

ctx.x: Well the way I look at it is this way, Helen, it's I used to even tell -- later after I'd worked for Ben and worked for Woody, I worked for them as a side man. And I think from being a leader it made me more alert to things that a leader likes or dislikes.
